sections.title: 商户定位（原资料描述）
sections.text: 位于曼哈顿 Midtown 的时尚、高性价比自助单人火锅与自助餐品牌，结合宽敞、活跃的社交氛围、一人一锅，以及食材、热菜和甜品选择。原资料面向都市上班族、学生及团体聚餐人群。
sections.original: SEE JOY is a trendy, high-value all-you-can-eat individual hot pot and buffet concept in midtown Manhattan. Combining a spacious, vibrant social atmosphere with a hygienic one-pot-per-person setup, it offers an expansive selection of fresh ingredients, hot entrees, and premium desserts. SEE JOY is the ultimate dining destination for urban professionals, students, and large groups seeking variety and a seamless gathering experience.

sections.title: 核心卖点（原资料描述）
sections.text: 一人一锅，每位客人有独立锅和汤底；两层空间，10,000+ 平方英尺、60+ 张桌，靠近 Penn Station；100+ 种食材，包括和牛、牛舌、海鲜、刺身及寿司；提供冷菜、水果和千层蛋糕；位于 Koreatown / Midtown，营业至深夜。
original: All-you-can-eat individual hot pot - one personal pot and broth per guest
10,000+ sq ft and 60+ tables across two floors, steps from Penn Station
100+ fresh ingredients including wagyu, beef tongue, seafood, sashimi and sushi
Buffet sides and desserts: cold appetizers, fresh fruit and mille crepe cakes
Open late in the heart of Koreatown / Midtown

sections.title: 目标客群（原资料列举，未排序）
sections.text: Midtown 上班族与 Penn Station / Herald Square 周边通勤者；游览 Madison Square Garden 和 Empire State Building 的游客；W 32nd St 韩国城晚间人群；团体聚餐或庆祝人群。
sections.original: Midtown office workers and commuters around Penn Station / Herald Square, tourists visiting Madison Square Garden and the Empire State Building, the evening crowd from Koreatown on W 32nd St, and large groups or celebrations (per brand positioning).

sections.title: 品牌性格（原资料描述）
sections.text: 活泼、现代、亲切、大方；以共同享用美食为纽带的社交聚点。
sections.original: Vibrant, modern, welcoming, and generous. A social hub that brings people together over a shared love for great food.

sections.title: 表达语气（原资料描述）
sections.text: 热情、时尚、轻松。像吃货朋友一样与客人交流，保持有活力、清楚、有邀请感。
sections.original: Enthusiastic, trendy, and casual. We speak to our guests like a foodie friend - always energetic, clear, and inviting.

sections.title: 代表餐品（资料清单）
sections.text: 单人火锅、鸳鸯锅、和牛、雪花牛肉、牛肉片、牛舌、三文鱼刺身、金枪鱼刺身、寿司卷、虾、蟹腿、北极贝、鱼丸、肉丸、饺子、千层蛋糕。
